implementation.name: add_task
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Handles the CLI command for adding a new task. Parses user input for title, description, priority, and due date, then calls the service layer to create the task.
implementation.pseudo_code:
IF no arguments provided
    PRINT usage message
    RETURN
SET title from first argument
SET description to empty string
SET priority to MEDIUM
SET due_date to None
FOR each argument after the first
    IF argument is '--desc'
        SET description
    IF argument is '--priority'
        SET priority (validate value)
    IF argument is '--due'
        SET due_date (validate format)
CALL service.create_task(title, description, priority, due_date)
PRINT task creation success and details

implementation.name: update_task
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Handles the CLI command for editing an existing task. Parses arguments for fields to update and calls the service layer.
implementation.pseudo_code:
IF no arguments provided
    PRINT usage message
    RETURN
SET task_id from first argument
INITIALIZE title, description, status, priority, due_date to None
FOR each argument after the first
    IF argument is '--title'
        SET title
    IF argument is '--desc'
        SET description
    IF argument is '--status'
        SET status (validate value)
    IF argument is '--priority'
        SET priority (validate value)
    IF argument is '--due'
        SET due_date (validate format)
CALL service.update_task(task_id, title, description, status, priority, due_date)
IF update successful
    PRINT success
ELSE
    PRINT not found

implementation.name: update_task
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Implements the business logic for updating a task. Updates fields if provided and sets updated_at.
implementation.pseudo_code:
GET Task by task_id
IF not found
    RETURN False
IF title provided
    UPDATE task.title
IF description provided
    UPDATE task.description
IF status provided
    UPDATE task.status
IF priority provided
    UPDATE task.priority
IF due_date provided
    UPDATE task.due_date
UPDATE task.updated_at
RETURN True

IF task_id not in tasks
    RETURN False
DELETE task from tasks dictionary
RETURN True
